name: Exp_ColorSchaffWPRTrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffWPRTrendCycle custom indicator, which applies a Schaff trend cycle to Williams' Percent Range (WPR) with fast and slow periods. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a bullish color zone and sell positions when it transitions from a bearish color zone, with configurable signal bar and threshold levels for entry and exit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffWPRTrendCycle自定义指标进行交易，该指标将Schaff趋势周期应用于快慢两期威廉指标(WPR)上。当指标从看涨颜色区域转换时开多仓，从看跌颜色区域转换时开空仓，具有可配置的信号K线和阈值水平用于入场和出场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用Schaff趋势周期对威廉指标(WPR)进行双重平滑处理来识别动量方向转换。入场条件方面，当指标缓冲区1的值大于5（看涨区域）且缓冲区0的值小于6时开多仓，当缓冲区1的值小于2（看跌区域）且缓冲区0的值大于1时开空仓。出场条件方面，看涨信号同时触发卖仓平仓，看跌信号同时触发买仓平仓，实现了信号反转即平仓的机制。仓位管理支持五种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除亏损后保证金比例、按扣除亏损后余额比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1，配合固定止损1000点和止盈2000点来控制单笔风险。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，但缺乏额外的趋势过滤器来避免震荡行情中的频繁交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses the Schaff Trend Cycle applied to Williams' Percent Range (WPR) with dual smoothing across fast and slow periods to identify momentum direction shifts. For entry conditions, a buy signal triggers when buffer 1 value exceeds 5 (bullish zone) and buffer 0 value is below 6, while a sell signal triggers when buffer 1 value is below 2 (bearish zone) and buffer 0 value exceeds 1. For exit conditions, a bullish signal simultaneously closes sell positions and a bearish signal closes buy positions, implementing a signal-reversal exit mechanism. Position sizing supports five margin modes including free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk ratio (default 0.1) combined with fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points to control per-trade risk. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar to prevent duplicate entries, but lacks additional trend filters to avoid frequent trading in choppy markets.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot size or money management ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：按自由保证金/余额/扣除亏损后保证金/扣除亏损后余额/固定手数

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（0=当前K线，1=已完成K线）

pros: 使用Schaff趋势周期对WPR进行平滑处理，能有效减少虚假信号和频繁震荡
提供五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好和账户规模
新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
买卖开关独立控制，可灵活配置只做单边或双边交易
止损止盈参数可配置，且止盈为止损的2倍，具备正期望收益比
pros_en: The Schaff Trend Cycle smoothing of WPR effectively reduces false signals and whipsaws
Five position sizing modes provide flexibility for different risk appetites and account sizes
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Independent buy/sell enable switches allow flexible configuration for directional or bi-directional trading
Configurable stop loss and take profit with a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio supports positive expectancy
cons: 缺乏趋势过滤器，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
止损1000点和止盈2000点对于H4周期来说偏大，可能导致较大回撤
没有点差过滤机制，高点差环境下入场成本较高
依赖自定义指标文件，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行且错误提示为乱码
信号逻辑基于颜色缓冲区的硬编码阈值(5,6,1,2)，缺乏自适应调节能力
cons_en: Lacks a trend filter, prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy markets
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are relatively large for H4 timeframe, potentially causing significant drawdowns
No spread filter mechanism, resulting in high entry costs in high-spread environments
Depends on a custom indicator file; if missing, the EA fails to run with garbled error messages
Signal logic relies on hardcoded color buffer thresholds (5,6,1,2) with no self-adaptive adjustment capability
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向或ATR波动率过滤），避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
增加点差过滤和最大持仓检查机制，提升交易安全性和资金管理完善度
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction or ATR volatility filter) to avoid frequent trading in choppy markets
Add spread filtering and maximum position checks to enhance trading safety and improve money management robustness

risk_points: 缺乏点差过滤，高点差环境下可能亏损入场
止损止盈点数偏大，单笔亏损可能较大
仓位管理依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，其内部实现的安全性未知
risk_points_en: No spread filter may cause loss-making entries in high-spread environments
Large stop loss and take profit point values may result in significant per-trade losses
Position sizing depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library with unknown internal safety implementation
